Name: Lover's Clothes
Author: Kyuya258369
Description:
[size=5]                                 [color=#ff0000]    [b]All my mods just upload to NEXUS.
                                   Please don't re-upload anywhere else
[/b][/color][/size][b][color=#ff0000]                             [size=5]我的所有mod只上传在N网，请不要二次上传到其他任何地方。[/size][/color]
[/b]


三套（六件）情侣装，每件衣服都是通用的。
Three sets (six piece) of couples' clothing, each piece of clothing is universal.
[color=#ff7700]
[b]24.02.11     增加FS版本，并为FS版本新增两个独特的配饰——披帛和斗篷。
24.02.11   Add FS version and add two unique accessories for FS version - brocade shawl and cloak.[/b][/color][b]
[/b]
[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]要求/Need[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]SMAPI, Json Assets/FS，CJB[/size]

[color=#00ffff][size=4][b]安装/Install[/b][/size][/color]
[size=3]1.下载并安装好所有前置。
1.Download and install all required.[/size]
[size=3]
2.下载本文件然后解压。
2.Download the pack and unzip it.[/size]
[size=3]
[color=#f1f1f1]3.将文件夹放入“Mods”中。[/color]
[color=#f1f1f1]3.Put the folder in "Mods".[/color]

[color=#ff7700]对于JA版本/For JA version：[/color]
[color=#f1f1f1]*除了文件夹以外，还有两张图片，一张是发型一张是配饰，请根据需要自行寻找教程进行使用。[/color]
[color=#f1f1f1]4.In addition to the folder, there are also two pictures, one for hairstyle and one for accessories. Please search for tutorials to use according to your needs.[/color]

[color=#f1f1f1]*除了帽子可以在帽子商店购买，其他部件并不能通过正常途径获得，需要下载CJB然后通过CJB获得。[/color]
[/size][color=#f4f4f4]5.Except hats are available at hat shops, shirts and pants which add by JA can't be available in the normal way.You could get them by CJB. [u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB’Nexus page

[/url][/u][/color][color=#ff7700][size=3]对于FS版本/For FS version：[/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3]*所有物品（包括头发，配饰等等）均可通过FS的手镜获得。并且FS版本比JA版本多两个配饰——披帛和斗篷。[/size][/color]
[size=3]*All items (including hair, accessories, etc.) can be obtained through FS's hand mirrors. And the FS version has two more accessories than the JA version - [b]brocade shawl and cloak.[/b][/size]

[size=3]*请仔细阅读每一个FS文件的描述，并根据需要选择下载。如果你都下载了，请在游戏中注意区分，XXX_1为物品包1的内容，XXX_2为物品包2的内容。[/size]
[size=3]*Please carefully read the description of each FS file and choose to download it as needed. If you have downloaded all of them, please pay attention to distinguishing them in the game. XXX_1 is the content of  pack 1, and XXX_2 is the content of pack 2.[/size]

[b][color=#00ffff][size=4]重要/Important[/size][/color][/b]
[size=3]1.这个模组适配我的体型mod。[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331][color=#e69138]click here[/color][/url][size=3]
1.This pack fits into another mod of mine. [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]click here[/url][size=3]
[/size]
2.你可以修改它以供你个人私下使用，但没有我的许可请不要再次上传。
2. You can edit this mod for your own use. But don't upload it anywhere again without my permission.
[size=3]
3.不要花钱去购买任何非作者授权发布的收费模组。
3. Please do not spend money on modules published by non authors for any reason.[/size]
